name: open-design-agent-kit
description: Open Design for Claude: design skills, ready-made design systems, and tools to make, check and export posters, social posts, slides and landing pages. Two plugins, pick one: open-design runs on your computer (needs Node.js), open-design-hosted uses the hosted server (no Node.js).

plugins.name: open-design
plugins.description: Runs the Open Design server on your computer (needs Node.js 18 or later) and saves designs in your folder. Make posters, social posts, slides, landing pages and prototypes, with ready-made design systems, checks and PDF, PNG or PowerPoint exports. No Node.js, or Node blocked at work? Install Open Design Hosted instead.

plugins.name: open-design-hosted
plugins.description: For computers without Node.js, or where Node is blocked: connects to the hosted Open Design server, so nothing runs on your computer. Same skills and tools as Open Design, but designs are saved on the server (anonymous, deleted after 7 days unused) and you get links instead of files. Install this or Open Design, not both.
